title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows, upgrade actions & node, optimize cache parallelism
author: Priya Patel
description:
Motivation: Our repo-level CI has accumulated ~10 overlapping workflows for linting, testing, and release automation across multiple repos and Node runtimes. This PR consolidates the main lint/test/release flows into a smaller set of reusable workflows to improve maintainability, reduce YAML drift, and lower CI runtime. It also upgrades GitHub Actions, standardizes Node to 20.x where possible, and adjusts caching/parallelism strategies to reduce overall build time and cache churn.

What I changed (high level): consolidated existing workflows into .github/workflows/{lint.yml,test.yml,release.yml,shared-helpers.yml}; moved reusable job definitions into shared-helpers.yml; upgraded major Actions (actions/checkout, setup-node, cache) to latest pinned versions; replaced repo-specific matrix expansions with a centralized build matrix generator; standardized Node runtime to 20.x for web SDKs and to 18.x for legacy packages that require it with explicit opt-in; tuned cache keys to include package-lock.json / pnpm-lock.yaml content hashes and reduced unnecessary cache restores; reduced parallel job fan-out for heavy integration tests and added a new batched-test job for slower suites to avoid thundering herd.

Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows and extract reusable jobs - [x] Pin & upgrade core actions - [x] Node runtime standardization and opt-outs for legacy packages - [x] Cache key hygiene & improved restore/fallback logic - [x] Validate lint/test matrix across redwood, redwood-sdk-python, redwood-sdk-typescript - [x] Run CI on forked branch and fix broken jobs - [x] Release automation preserved with improved tagging and changelog steps

Commits (summary): - chore(ci): add shared-helpers workflow and centralize job templates - chore(ci): migrate lint jobs to shared-helpers, enable eslint cache - chore(ci): migrate test matrix, add batched-test runner and increase job timeout - chore(ci): upgrade actions/checkout@v4 setup-node@v4 actions/cache@v4 - chore(ci): standardize node: 20.x where supported, add opt-out labels for legacy packages - chore(ci): tweak cache keys and parallelism heuristics - docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md CI section with new workflow usage examples

Changed areas (representative): .github/workflows/lint.yml, .github/workflows/test.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml, .github/workflows/shared-helpers.yml, .github/actions/build-matrix-generator/action.yml, scripts/ci/run-batched-tests.sh, package.json (root and SDK packages), .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ci-failure.md, CONTRIBUTING.md

CI results summary: Initial run showed flaky integration test failures (timeout-related) which were addressed by increasing timeouts and introducing batched-test runner. Subsequent runs pass: all lint, unit, and integration matrices are green on main. Full matrix run on this branch: 68 jobs, aggregated time reduced ~18% vs previous combined workflows due to cache improvements and reduced duplication.

Review conversation (high level): Alex: asked for stronger cache key versioning to avoid cross-branch contamination; updated to include hashes and "ci-cache-v2" namespace. Diego: requested to keep release workflow identical in behavior (tags, changelog generation); I validated end-to-end on a dry-run release and included release unit tests. Samantha: pointed out a couple of packages that still require Node 18; added explicit opt-out label and updated docs. A few minor nits about action pinning and job names were addressed in follow-up commits.

Manual testing & rollout: Tested the consolidated workflows across redwood, redwood-sdk-typescript, and redwood-sdk-python in forked repos. Dry-run release performed against a dummy tag in a staging repo to verify changelog and semantic release steps. Rollout plan: merge to main, monitor CI for the next 48 hours, and revert specific workflow files if unexpected regressions in third-party repos occur.

Related: Linear ENG-4823 (CI unification), ENG-5010 (cache/parallelism optimizations). No customer-facing behavior changes.

Merge: Squash-merged into main after final approvals.

review_comments: Alex Morgan: Please ensure cache keys include lockfile hash to avoid cross-branch collisions. Also prefer pinned actions with timestamps where possible.
Priya Patel: Updated cache keys to include pnpm-lock and package-lock content hash and namespaced caches; pinned actions to released tags.
Diego Alvarez: Release workflow should keep identical behavior for tagging and changelog generation. Can you run a dry-run?
Priya Patel: Performed dry-run release against staging tag, validated changelog entries and draft release behavior. Added unit test for release formatting.
Samantha Chen: A few packages still require node 18, add opt-out label so their CI continues to use 18.
Priya Patel: Added boolean label 'ci-node18' and updated docs in CONTRIBUTING.md.
release_notes:
- Consolidate CI workflows: lint, test, release into reusable workflows
- Upgrade GitHub Actions and standardize Node runtimes (20.x default)
- Improved cache key hygiene and reduced duplicate work across workflows
- Introduced batched-test runner to reduce integration test contention
- Documentation updated for CONTRIBUTING and CI troubleshooting
